maya: Quick check — when the edge does upstream fanout and one path fails midstream, what should be our canonical fallback priority? Want to align streaming vs non-streaming behavior.
andre: Historically we picked lowest latency, then lowest cost. Streaming/resume changes that because we need KV cache alignment to resume safely.
kevin: I think for streaming routes we should prefer resume-compatible variants first even if slightly higher latency. Falling back to stateless kills continuity and is visible to clients.
sasha: Agree, but we can’t keep unlimited KVCACHE snapshots. Memory + concurrent streams will blow up if we try to hold a bunch of checkpoints.
andre: Proposal sketch: prefer resume_compatible -> if not available or checkpoint OOM risk, then attempt a short-grace stateless fallback. If we go stateless midstream, emit a trailer flag so client knows continuity is broken.
maya: Example config snippet to discuss: 
```
fallback_policy:
  - prefer: resume_compatible
    max_latency_ms: 1200
    max_kv_snapshot_bytes: 16MB
  - prefer: stateless
    max_cost_multiplier: 0.8
    emit_trailer_flag: true
```
kevin: We also need metrics: fallback.reason, fallback.target_variant, resume_success_rate, kv_snapshot_count. Add a streaming SLO: resume_success_rate >= 99.5% for premium routes.
sasha: Also edge should advertise upstream capability header, e.g. `X-Resume-Capability: none|soft|full` so proxies can make deterministic routing choices.
deploybot: deploybot: staging rollout of fallback-policy v2 started for svc/edge at 2026-03-23T15:02Z :rocket:
maya: SG. I’ll open a short RFC PR capturing tradeoffs: memory vs latency vs client-visible continuity and include the config defaults. Any objections to the priority order (resume_compatible -> stateless)?
kevin: :thumbsup: I’ll add perf tests for concurrent KV snapshot retention and handshake latency under load.
sasha: Small ops note: when fallback occurs midstream, ensure we attach an event id to logs/audit so we can replay/triage truncated conversations.
maya: Thanks — if no objections I’ll push the RFC later today and tag infra/edge for review.
